title: mazus miquelii var. rotundifolius

This plant is traditionally used in herbal medicine, where it is valued for its ability to aid digestion, relieve respiratory issues, and reduce inflammation. The health benefits of Mazus miquelii var. rotundifolius include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antiviral properties, which may help to alleviate symptoms of colds, flu, and other respiratory infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include iridoid glycosides, phenolic acids, and flavonoids, which may contribute to its therapeutic actions of anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant activity.
